get_table_schema.description: Get the field schema for one or more tables.

table_ids.description: List of table IDs to get the schema for.

list_databases.description: List all databases in the workspace. Use this to discover database IDs before listing tables.

list_table_rows.description: List rows from a table with optional search and pagination. Returns rows with user-facing field names as keys.

search.description: Optional search term to filter rows.

size.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

table_id.description: The ID of the table to list rows from.

list_tables.description: List all tables in the workspace, optionally filtered by database.

database_id.description: If provided, only return tables from this database.
